customerHint: Invoices and credit notes issued to your company by Chuo-Sogo. Download the PDF for your records.
dueDateHint: Leave the due date empty to use the payment terms from the issuer details.
issueHint: Issuing assigns the next invoice number, creates the PDF and makes the document permanent. Corrections are made with a credit note.
issuerHint: Printed on every invoice. Changes apply to documents issued from now on; issued documents keep the details they were issued with.
rounding: Tax rounding (once per rate per invoice)
serverComputes: Totals and consumption tax per rate are calculated by the server when you save.

savings.title: Savings and our fee
savings.terms: {{share}}% of each saving, for {{months}} months ({{from}} – {{to}}). No monthly fee.
savings.rule: Saving = (price paid before − price now) × quantity, counted when the order is completed. If the price did not go down, the fee is 0.
savings.baselinesHint: Fixed once per item: your own last purchase before the start date, or a price you confirmed. Orders placed through us never change it.
savings.awaitingFactory: Waiting for the factory to confirm
savings.termsFixed: Fixed: savings were already counted under these terms.
savings.invoiceCreated: Draft created. Review and issue it under Billing.
savings.agreedHint: For items without a purchase record: enter the price the factory paid before and where it comes from. It counts only after the factory confirms it.
savings.fixFromRecords: Fix baselines from the factory's records
savings.fixedFromRecords: {{fixed}} baseline(s) fixed, {{waiting}} waiting for the factory to confirm.
